description: Focused native-versus-Metal process ABI conformance. Passing entries prove only the named fixture and recorded configuration.

cases.negative_control: The fixture checks NZCV and authenticates the first and last of 4097 signatures. Its optional wrong-modifier argument exercises authentication rejection.
cases.evidence_level: Exact native and strict Metal stdout, stderr and exit status.

cases.test_target: component-manifest case; freestanding executable is compiled and run natively and through runtime launch
cases.negative_control: None; the fixture asserts two ordered records, identity/user data, 72-byte stride fields, and zeroed extension output.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match

cases.test_target: component-manifest case; pthread executable is compiled and run natively and through runtime launch
cases.negative_control: Checks two raw sigsuspend calls return EINTR, restore the blocked mask, and deliver one-shot handlers across separate signals.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match

cases.test_target: component-manifest case; Darwin raw-syscall executable is compiled and run natively and through runtime launch
cases.domain: POSIX file descriptors and raw Darwin syscalls
cases.negative_control: Fixture asserts ENOENT, EBADF, carry/errno preservation, read/EOF/close and raw write behavior.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match

cases.test_target: component-manifest case; open/append executable is compiled and run natively and through runtime launch
cases.domain: POSIX file I/O and filesystem effects
cases.negative_control: Checks append after seek for named open and raw open_nocancel, resulting bytes, final offset, and cleanup of created files.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match plus fixture cleanup assertion

cases.test_target: component-manifest case; AF_UNIX executable is compiled and run natively and through runtime launch
cases.negative_control: Fixture asserts socket creation/close and native errno results for invalid type, protocol, domain, and closed descriptor.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match

cases.test_target: component-manifest case; handled BRK executable is compiled and run natively and through runtime launch
cases.negative_control: Checks six BRK immediates reach SIGTRAP handlers with expected signal/code, saved PC address, resumed instruction stream, and a skipped neighbor.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match

cases.test_target: Native and guest delivery of UDF imm16 synchronous faults
cases.negative_control: Skips an untaken UDF, then catches six immediates including 1 and 65535. Each handler sees the faulting PC and resumes at PC+4.
cases.evidence_level: Exact native and guest signal number, fault code, fault address agreement and resume counts.

cases.test_target: component-manifest case; default-termination executable is compiled and run natively and through runtime launch
cases.negative_control: The fixture deliberately leaves SIGTRAP at its default disposition; raw returncode -5 and normalized status 133 distinguish signal termination from the ordinary-exit-133 control.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr exact match; raw returncode -5 and normalized status 133 match

cases.test_target: component-manifest case; ARM64 SIMD executable is compiled and run natively and through runtime launch
cases.negative_control: None; exercises in-range, out-of-range, and wrapped byte indices for TBL/TBX.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match
cases.coverage_boundary: Process-level translated output only; custom AOT SIMD fallback means this does not prove typed GPU-interpreter packet coverage.

cases.test_target: Native and translated Metal process launch
cases.negative_control: Distinct signed and unsigned byte matrices, 32-bit accumulator wrap, and aliased operands
cases.evidence_level: Native and guest stdout, stderr and exit status with six output lines and 24 result words
cases.coverage_boundary: SMMLA, UMMLA and USMMLA through process translation

cases.test_target: Native and translated Metal process launch
cases.negative_control: Exact negative and positive ties, final saturation and cancellation with FPSR.QC both clear and pre-seeded
cases.evidence_level: Full vector register and FPSR matched native on all 104 output rows
cases.coverage_boundary: SQRDMLAH and SQRDMLSH with 16- and 32-bit elements, scalar and vector, regular and indexed

cases.test_target: component-manifest case; ARM64 SIMD executable is compiled and run natively and through runtime launch
cases.negative_control: None; exercises positive/negative saturation, extreme shift counts, and pre-seeded FPSR QC state.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match
cases.coverage_boundary: Process-level translated output only; custom AOT SIMD fallback means this does not prove typed GPU-interpreter packet coverage.

cases.test_target: verify-workloop-debounce; native and runtime launch of the raw kevent_qos workloop debounce fixture
cases.negative_control: Fixture checks valid priority encodings and expected EINVAL behavior for invalid QoS/fflags combinations.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match

cases.test_target: voucher-traps executable with argument e; task_set_exception_ports null-clear validation only
cases.negative_control: Compares null-port clear and invalid mask, behavior, flavor, task, descriptor type, and right results; does not cover installing or delivering a valid exception handler.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match

cases.test_target: raw-fd-lifecycle-contract; freestanding syscall fixture with an immutable 18-byte input
cases.negative_control: Fixture verifies dup-shared offset, fstat size, close, and EBADF from fstat/lseek/dup/close after descriptor closure.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match plus read-only input hash receipt

cases.test_target: mkdtemp-contract; valid temporary-directory creation and cleanup plus missing-parent error
cases.domain: libc temporary-directory creation and filesystem effects
cases.negative_control: Requires a unique 0700 directory, correct returned template pointer, successful cleanup, and ENOENT with no path creation when parent is missing.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match plus fixture cleanup assertion

cases.test_target: exit-status-133; normal process return control for signal-normalized status 133
cases.domain: Process exit and signal status distinction
cases.negative_control: Returns status 133 normally; raw subprocess returncode 133 must differ from SIGTRAP termination returncode -5 despite the same shell-normalized status.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest normalized status 133 and raw returncode 133 exact match

cases.test_target: fp-compare-exceptions-contract; native and guest scalar FP compare exception matrix
cases.domain: ARM64 scalar floating-point comparisons and exception flags
cases.negative_control: Outputs the scalar compare/result/FPSR matrix across rounding/exception inputs; exact native-versus-guest bytes and all 168 output lines are required.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match with 168 stdout lines

cases.test_target: open-variadic-mode-contract; variadic open with poisoned x2 and filesystem mode validation
cases.domain: POSIX variadic open ABI and filesystem permissions
cases.negative_control: Poisoned x2 must not replace variadic mode 0600; fixture checks created file mode and removes both file and temporary directory.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match plus fixture filesystem assertions

cases.test_target: simd-fp-minmax-nan-contract; vector FP min/max NaN and signed-zero matrix
cases.negative_control: Compares fmax/fmin/fmaxnm/fminnm across three NaN and signed-zero vectors and four FPCR modes; all 48 output rows are required.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match with 48 stdout lines
cases.coverage_boundary: Process-level translated output only; custom SIMD fallback does not prove typed GPU-interpreter packet coverage.

cases.test_target: af-unix-stream-socketpair; raw socketpair copyout, bidirectional stream I/O, invalid cases, and EOF
cases.negative_control: Checks bidirectional stream payloads, invalid descriptors/family/domain/type/output pointers, peer close, and EOF against native results.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match

cases.test_target: verify-dynamic-import-stub build rules; dlopen/dlsym call through an explicit provider path
cases.domain: dyld named dynamic imports and dylib loading
cases.negative_control: None; provider exports dynamic_import_length and the executable verifies the resolved call, output length 16, and dlclose success.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match plus provider source hash receipt

cases.test_target: verify-dynamic-tlv build rules; explicit dylib import across pthread TLS isolation and close/reopen
cases.domain: dyld dynamic TLS and per-thread storage
cases.negative_control: Asserts per-thread initial TLS, worker-local updates, main-thread isolation, and stored TLS state after dlclose/reopen.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match plus provider source hash receipt

cases.test_target: cpp/Makefile MACH_VM_MEMORY_ENTRY_NATIVE exact clang rule; native and runtime launch
cases.domain: Mach VM read-only memory entries and mappings
cases.negative_control: Checks invalid source rejection, shared read-only alias updates, denied writable map, source/port release behavior, stale entry rejection, and remap after alias release.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stdout/stderr/status exact match

cases.test_target: posix-spawn-cooperative-wait; native and guest cooperative child wait/reap lifecycle
cases.domain: POSIX process spawn and waitpid synchronization
cases.negative_control: A sibling releases a waiting child; fixture asserts WNOHANG zero before release, exactly one waiter reaps exit 23, the other receives ECHILD, and emits cooperative-wait released=1 nohang_zero=1 waited_matches=1 single_reap=1 exited23=1.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest exact stdout/stderr/status parity against the literal cooperative-wait result

cases.test_target: posix-spawn-pipeline; native and guest stdin/stdout pipe handoff with ordered file actions
cases.domain: POSIX process spawn and pipe-backed standard streams
cases.negative_control: Uses ordered dup2/close file actions, parent stdin EOF, child transformation, exact output, and exit 23; a closed pipe source must return EBADF without spawning. Expected stdout is exactly `posix_spawn pipeline ok\n`.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest exact stdout/stderr/status parity against the expected pipeline marker

cases.test_target: verify-dyld-add-image-native; local root and dependency add-image notifications with stable native-versus-Metal output
cases.negative_control: Fixture checks failed dlopen emits no callback, then root and dependency callback order, callback header and slide validity for every initial and added image, dependency-first constructors, and exported provider value 42.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stable stdout/stderr/status exact match; initial enumeration cardinality intentionally omitted

cases.test_target: verify-dyld-add-image-native; reentrant local load from add-image callback with stable native-versus-Metal output
cases.domain: dyld reentrant local dylib image notifications
cases.negative_control: Fixture checks failed dlopen leaves image count and callback record unchanged; callback performs a nested load, then asserts the nested load completed, the expected three images were added, and reentrant event order is RNrDO.
cases.evidence_level: native-and-guest stable stdout/stderr/status exact match; initial enumeration cardinality intentionally omitted and initial replay is not asserted
